teacher_lines.roman: Electron transport ki energy seedhe ADP ko nahi milti, toh ATP banane tak kaise pahunchti hai?
Electron transport ki energy ATP banane tak H⁺ ka fark banaakar pahunchti hai; unka lautna ATP synthesis chalaata hai.
Thylakoid ki band thaili yaad karo: andar lumen hai aur bahar stroma hai.
H⁺ positive hydrogen ion hai; ADP aur inorganic phosphate se ATP banane mein energy lagti hai.
Ab ek dhalaan socho: ek taraf H⁺ zyada hain, doosri taraf kam hain.
Isi zyada-se-kam ki dhalaan ko gradient kehte hain; iske saath particles apne-aap kam wali taraf jaa sakte hain.
Membrane ke dono taraf H⁺ ki concentration aur electrical haalat ke fark ko proton gradient kehte hain.
Is fark ko electrochemical kehte hain: electro yaani charge ka fark; chemical yaani concentration ka fark.
Ab ATP banne ko samjhaane ke liye ek vichaar rakho: H⁺ jama honge, phir unka lautna ATP banwaayega.
Is tarah pehle rakhi gayi explanation ko hypothesis kehte hain; use experiments se jaanchte hain, sirf maan nahi lete.
Hamaari is hypothesis mein membrane paar H⁺ ka jaana chemical kaam, yaani ATP banana, chalaata hai.
Isi jod ka naam chemiosmotic hai: chemi yahaan chemical kaam batata hai, aur osmotic membrane ke paar movement.
Isliye ATP banne ki is explanation ko chemiosmotic hypothesis kehte hain.
Photosynthesis mein H⁺ thylakoid lumen mein jama hote hain, stroma mein nahi.
Respiration mein bhi membrane ke aar-paar proton gradient ATP synthesis se juda hai.
Respiration ka poora kaam aage dekhenge; abhi mitochondrion ki outer aur inner membrane socho.
Inke beech ki jagah intermembrane space hai; inter yahaan beech ka matlab deta hai.
Respiration ki electron transport system, ya ETS, chalne par H⁺ isi space mein jama hote hain.
Yaad rakho, mitochondrial accumulation intermembrane space mein hai, matrix mein nahi.
Aap ek baandh socho: ek taraf paani jama hai, doosri taraf level neecha hai.
teacher_lines.note: analogy · screen: Baandh aur turbine ke saath thylakoid membrane, proton gradient aur ATP synthase ki tulna.

teacher_lines.roman: Paani upar jama karne mein energy lagi; ab use turbine ke raaste neeche behne do.
Us bahav se turbine kaam kar sakti hai; jama energy ab kaam mein aa rahi hai.
Yahaan baandh thylakoid membrane hai, paani ke levels ka fark proton gradient hai.
Turbine ki jagah ATP banane wala enzyme socho; iska naam ATP synthase hai.
Synthase ka matlab kisi cheez ko banaane wala enzyme hai; yahaan banne wali cheez ATP hai.
Ab hum pehle H⁺ jama hona, phir unke lautne se ATP banna samjhenge.
Yaad karo, light electron ko excited karti hai; carriers use aage le jaate hain.
teacher_lines.note: overview · screen: Wahi thylakoid cutaway; teen numbered jagah par water splitting, carrier transport aur stromal NADP⁺ reduction.

teacher_lines.roman: Isi excited hone ko yahaan activation of electrons kehte hain.
Ab hum isi safar mein gradient banane wale teen kaam dhoondhenge.
Pehla, water splitting lumen mein H⁺ deti hai.
Doosra, carrier stroma se H⁺ lumen mein le jaata hai.
Teesra, NADPH banne mein stroma ke H⁺ istemal hote hain.
Phir dekhenge ki H⁺ ka ATP synthase se lautna kya kaam karta hai.

teacher_lines.roman: Water-splitting complex ki jagah yaad karo: PS II se juda, lumen ki taraf khulta hai.
teacher_lines.note: explain · screen: Lumen-facing water splitting par do H₂O se chaar H⁺ lumen mein judte hain; electron aur oxygen arrows shaant rehte hain.

teacher_lines.roman: Do waters ka hisaab tha: 2H₂O → 4H⁺ + O₂ + 4e⁻.
Protons or hydrogen ions, dono yahaan H⁺ ke naam hain.
Aap machinery ka face dekho; kya in H⁺ ko pehle stroma se membrane paar karni padegi?
In H⁺ ko stroma se membrane paar nahi karni padegi, kyunki water splitting lumen-facing side par hoti hai.
Reaction inner side par hoti hai, isliye H⁺ seedhe lumen mein milte hain.
Baandh wali tasveer mein pehla kaam mila: jama hone wali taraf H⁺ badh gaye.
Reaction centre ka electron pehle primary acceptor leta hai, phir carriers use aage dete hain.
teacher_lines.note: explain · screen: Wahi membrane picture mein carrier stromal H⁺ leta aur lumen mein chhodta hai; electron aur proton arrows alag rang mein.

teacher_lines.roman: Ab aisa carrier socho jo electron ke saath hydrogen ka hissa bhi le jaaye.
Isi ko H carrier kehte hain; H hydrogen ka sanket hai.
Outer-side primary acceptor se electron is H carrier tak pahunchta hai.
Electron lete waqt carrier stroma se H⁺ bhi leta hai.
Ab aap inner side dekho: electron agle carrier ko mila, H⁺ lumen mein chhoot gaya.
Water splitting ne H⁺ andar diye the; yahaan stroma ke H⁺ bhi kaise ghat gaye?
Yahaan stroma ke H⁺ isliye ghate kyunki carrier unhe lekar lumen mein chhod aaya.
Isi stroma-se-lumen movement ke kaaran bahar H⁺ kam aur andar zyada hote hain.
Electron aur H⁺ ke safar jude hain, lekin dono ka raasta ek nahi hai.
Yaad karo, PS I ke acceptor se aaye electrons aakhir NADP⁺ ko milte hain.
teacher_lines.note: explain · screen: PS I se stromal NADP reductase tak electrons; NADPH formation mein stromal H⁺ istemal hota hai, lumen ki taraf proton arrow nahi.

teacher_lines.roman: NADP⁺ electrons leta hai; isi electron lene ko reduction kehte hain.
NADP reductase yeh badlav karaata hai; woh electrons ka mool source nahi hai.
Yeh enzyme stroma ki taraf kaam karta hai; isi face ko stroma side kehte hain.
Aap pehle ka hisaab dekho: NADP⁺ + 2e⁻ + H⁺ → NADPH.
NADPH banne mein yeh H⁺ kahaan se aata hai?
NADPH banne mein yeh H⁺ stroma se aata hai, isliye wahaan bache H⁺ aur ghatte hain.
Aksar lagta hai ki teesra kaam bhi H⁺ ko lumen bhejta hai, par aisa nahi hai.
Yahaan H⁺ stromal reaction mein istemal hua; isi se dono taraf ka fark badha.
Ab aap do water molecules wala example teenon kaamon se jodo.
teacher_lines.note: example · screen: Lumen mein water splitting se +4 H⁺ aur transported H⁺; stroma mein transport aur NADPH formation se H⁺ kam. Lumen pH neeche jaata hai.

teacher_lines.roman: Water splitting ke chaar H⁺ lumen mein mile; carrier ne aur H⁺ andar pahunchaye.
Saath hi NADPH banne mein stroma ke H⁺ istemal hue.
Isliye lumen mein H⁺ zyada aur stroma mein kam hote gaye.
Yeh fark thylakoid membrane ke aar-paar hai, chloroplast ki baahari boundary par nahi.
Ab zyada H⁺ wale ghol ko socho: uski acidity badh jaati hai.
Acidity bataane wale scale ko pH kehte hain; H⁺ ki concentration badhe toh pH ghatta hai.
Isliye lumen ka pH ghatta hai, aur is kami ko naapa ja sakta hai.

questions.question: Gradient aur ATP synthase ke beech actual connection kya hai?
questions.hook: In-text challenge: proton gradient mein itni interest kyun—sirf H⁺ jama karne se ATP ban jayega?

points.point: Why are we so interested in the proton gradient?

This gradient is important because it is the breakdown of this gradient that leads to the synthesis of ATP. The gradient is broken down due to the movement of protons across the membrane to the stroma

channel of the CF₀ of the ATP synthase. The ATP synthase enzyme consists of two parts: one called the CF₀ is embedded in the thylakoid membrane and forms a transmembrane channel that carries out facil

The break down of the gradient provides enough energy to cause a conformational change in the CF₁ particle of the ATP synthase, which makes the enzyme synthesise several molecules of energy-packed ATP

film.showing_moment: ATP synthase ka enlarged local section, CF₀ channel, CF₁ head aur lumen-to-stroma H⁺ path.

teacher_lines.roman: Ab lumen mein H⁺ jama hain, lekin ADP mein phosphate judna abhi samjhaana baaki hai.
teacher_lines.note: checkpoint · screen: High-lumen aur low-stroma H⁺; ATP synthase ki jagah lumen-to-stroma return ka adhura raasta.

teacher_lines.roman: Ruko, pehle khud socho: proton gradient mein hamaari itni dilchaspi kyun hai?
Proton gradient mein dilchaspi isliye hai kyunki H⁺ ka sahi raaste lautna ATP synthesis ko energy deta hai.
Aap baandh se turbine ki taraf bahav yaad karo; sirf paani jama karna kaafi nahi tha.
Ab hum proton return ka woh protein raasta kholenge.
Ab aap membrane mein laga proton return ka raasta dekho.
teacher_lines.note: explain · screen: Ussi thylakoid ka enlargement: membrane mein CF₀, stroma mein CF₁; lumen → CF₀ → stroma proton arrow aur ghatta gradient.

teacher_lines.roman: ADP aur inorganic phosphate jodkar ATP banane wala enzyme ATP synthase hai.
Synthase ka banaane wala matlab hum turbine ki tasveer mein khol chuke hain.
Is enzyme ke do hisse hain: membrane mein dhansa CF₀ aur stroma ki taraf nikla CF₁.
CF₀ proton channel hai; CF₁ membrane ki outer stromal surface par nikla head hai.
Channel membrane ke aar-paar hai; aise aar-paar faile hone ko transmembrane kehte hain.
Ab particles ka apne-aap zyada concentration se kam ki taraf phailna socho.
Isi phailne ko diffusion kehte hain; yahaan H⁺ electrochemical gradient ki disha mein chalte hain.
Protein ka raasta milne par aise paar jaane ko facilitated diffusion kehte hain.
Facilitated ka matlab yahaan raasta milne se aasaan hua hai.
H⁺ CF₀ se lumen se stroma lautte hain, kyunki unka electrochemical gradient isi disha mein hai.
Lautne se dono taraf ka fark ghatta hai; isi ko breakdown of this gradient kehte hain.
Aksar lagta hai ki protons toot gaye, par asal mein unki dono taraf ki asamaanta ghati hai.
Is fark mein jama energy proton return par milti hai, isliye ATP synthesis chal sakti hai.
Aapne CF₀ ka raasta aur CF₁ ka stromal head dekh liya.
teacher_lines.note: explain · screen: Ussi CF₀–CF₁ enlargement mein proton return ke saath CF₁ ki banawat badalti hai; ADP + Pᵢ se kai ATP bante hain.

teacher_lines.roman: Par H⁺ ka bahav ADP aur phosphate jodne ka kaam kaise chalaata hai?
H⁺ ka bahav yeh kaam protein ki banawat badalne ki energy dekar chalaata hai.
Protein ki teen dishaon mein phaili banawat uski conformation hai.
Conformational ka matlab isi banawat se juda hai; iske badalne ko conformational change kehte hain.
Gradient breakdown ki energy CF₁ mein yahi badlav karaati hai.
Isse enzyme ATP ke kai molecules banaata hai; kai ke liye yahaan several kaha gaya hai.
In ATP molecules mein kaam ke liye energy hoti hai, isliye inhe energy-packed keh rahe hain.
Aap yahaan ek H⁺ se ek ATP ka fixed anupaat mat nikaalna.
Ab hum baandh aur turbine ka poora sambandh biological naam se jodte hain.
teacher_lines.note: retell · screen: Wahi thylakoid picture par chaar requirements; pehle inward pumping, phir CF₀ se outward return aur CF₁ par ATP formation.

teacher_lines.roman: Pehle proton gradient banao, phir ATP synthase se H⁺ lautaakar ATP banao; yahi chemiosmosis hai.
Chemiosmosis ko chaar cheezein chahiye: membrane, proton pump, proton gradient aur ATP synthase.
Energy lagaakar H⁺ membrane ke paar jama karne wali machinery proton pump hai.
Thylakoid lumen wahi andar ki jagah hai, jahaan humne high H⁺ concentration dekhi.
Pehle pumping mein energy lagti hai; waapas gradient ki disha mein diffusion se energy milti hai.
ATP synthase channel waapasi ka raasta deta hai; enzyme mili energy se ATP formation karaata hai.
Aap order jodo: gradient bana, CF₀ se H⁺ laute, CF₁ ki banawat badli, ATP bana.
Electron seedhe ADP se judkar ATP nahi bana raha.

teacher_lines.roman: Thylakoid membrane band boundary hai; ismein photosystems, carriers aur ATP synthase lage hain.
Bahar Stroma (low H⁺), ya Stroma, hai; andar Lumen (high H⁺) mein H⁺ zyada hain.
Pehle electron route dekho: Light ke arrows P680, PS II aur P700, PS I tak pahunchte hain.
PS ka matlab photosystem hai; P680 aur P700 unke reaction centres hain.
PS II ke paas H₂O se Oxidation of water hoti hai; ½O₂ + H⁺ uske products dikhata hai.
½O₂ ek water ka proportional oxygen hisaab hai; alag aadha oxygen molecule nahi tair raha.
Water ke electrons PS II ko milte hain; ab aap arrow PQ tak dekho.
PQ ka naam Plastoquinone hai; electrons aur do H⁺ lekar iska reduced form PQH₂ banta hai.
Agla Cytochrome B6f membrane complex hai; B6f iski pehchaan, aur proton arrow lumen ki taraf hai.
PC, ya Plastocyanin, electron ko B6f se P700, PS I tak pahunchata hai.
Yahaan light doosri excitation deti hai; phir stromal side par Fd electron leta hai.
Fd ferredoxin hai; isse electron FNR, ya ferredoxin–NADP⁺ reductase, tak pahunchta hai.
FNR enzyme NADP⁺ reduction karaata hai; NADP⁺ + H⁺ aur NADPH labels starting substances aur product jodte hain.
Ab aap H⁺ arrows alag padho: carrier stroma se leta, lumen mein chhodta hai.
Water oxidation bhi lumen H⁺ badhaati hai; NADPH formation stromal H⁺ ghataati hai.
Repeated H⁺ labels protons hain; green return arrow unhe ATP synthase se stroma laata hai.
High Electrochemical Potential Gradient se Low ki wedge lumen-to-stroma disha dikhati hai.
Is electrochemical fark mein charge aur concentration, dono ke asar yaad rakho.
Return arrow membrane ke CF₀ channel se guzarta hai; CF₁, ATP synthase ka head, stroma mein hai.
Head ke paas ADP + Pᵢ → ATP hai; ADP adenosine diphosphate, Pᵢ inorganic phosphate hai.
ATP adenosine triphosphate hai; aap electron route NADPH tak aur proton return stroma tak alag rakho.
Ab aap membrane par bana ATP aur electron movement se bana NADPH ek saath dekho.
teacher_lines.note: explain · screen: Wahi thylakoid se ATP aur NADPH surrounding stroma ki sugar-forming reactions tak; CO₂ carbon organic molecule mein judta hai.

teacher_lines.roman: ATP energy deta hai; NADPH naye organic compounds banane ke liye electrons deta hai.
Dono taiyaar hain, lekin ab inka kaam chloroplast ke kis hisse mein hoga?
Inka kaam surrounding stroma mein hoga, jahaan sugar banane ki reactions hoti hain.
Sugar banane ko energy aur electrons chahiye, isliye ATP aur NADPH dono turant in reactions mein lagte hain.
Naye jeev-padarth banane ke is kaam ko biosynthetic kehte hain; aage hum iske steps kholenge.
In reactions mein CO₂ ka carbon organic molecule mein judta hai; isi ko fixing CO₂ kehte hain.
Is CO₂ fixation ka poora raasta aage dekhenge; abhi ise stroma mein sugar banne se jodo.
Shuruaat ka jod mil gaya: electron transport H⁺ ka fark banaata hai, ATP synthase uski energy kaam mein leta hai.
Ab ATP ki energy aur NADPH ke electrons taiyaar hain; agle heading mein dekhenge ki stroma inhe sugar banane mein kahaan lagaata hai.
